# KB1c: admission-ready evidence for the typed-window z4 typed-echo schedule (no new kappa)

Agent: **Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed). No model is named. Base main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (assignment-pinned; canonical main moved to `6bd33bc0b87a01e9c9d8b1c01576f3ddbcaee850` during the session — every pinned chain input is byte-identical there except the task catalogue, which this package pins to the base revision; see Baseline below); priority revision 4; selected record unchanged; **no new kappa and no supplier admission**.

Package: `research/z4-typed-window-admission-kb1c/`. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18954210

## What this is

https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2464 built the first hosted supplier instantiation of the certified z4 typed echo (whole-construction pricing, `a < D/E`) and stopped on one hosting obstruction. https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2595 removed that obstruction: legal per-call sequential immutable COPY/ERASE windows with per-call totals delivery keep a positive whole-construction saving at k=2 (384 records literal / 304 typed against the priced 608 baseline, typed relabeling priced at zero extra). This package carries the schedule the last mile: it runs the pinned [PR 1087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087) chain's own admission/consistency machinery against the typed-window declarations as far as non-invasive execution reaches, produces the exact evidence bundle (inputs hashed, boundary contracts, dirty-column counts, the priced ledger), records the exact stage and error of every hard blocker, and states the named maintainer decisions that remain. **A maintainer can act on this in one step; nothing in the frozen chain, the selected record or the selected frontier is changed here.**

## The frozen chain runs fresh, unmodified

The full strict T16 replay (`research/gauge44-slots-t16/verify_t16.py`) runs end to end on the retained local word of the pinned [PR 1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042) replay archive: all eleven stages (`restore-parent, bind8, lift16, bind, emit, audit, invoice, assembly, admission-controls, bit-supplier-controls, independent-t16`), verdict `PASS_GAUGE44_T16_STRICT_GLOBAL_REPLAY` at kappa `1672188119205421/1000000000000000000` (0.001672188119205421 — the [PR 1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042) composition, not the selected 0.001672660197076918). Controls run fresh: 69 admission controls (every mutation rejected, none accepted), 12 bit-supplier controls (derived deficit 10272), 15 controller mutations, 6 independent-t16 controls, 47 strict outer margins all positive. Binding inventory: 69,120 roles, 144 complete calls, prefix 397 at charge 512, physical row coefficient 16,469 below 20,161. The owner receipt reproduces the archived receipt byte-exactly (SHA-256 `888d63e292eed39215fe9f1440b15018f71507e13132f0e02bf0c636d56908e6`); the invoice receipt and stage outputs are semantically identical to the archive (byte differences are one receipt's JSON key order and the absolute paths `independent-t16` records).

## Evidence bundle

**Inputs hashed** (RESULT.json): all chain code/data/engine files, the [PR 386](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/386) contract text, the frozen replay archive and its eight receipt members, the task catalogue and selected record, and the vendored PR 2595 machine receipt (`inputs/PR2595-RESULT.json`, SHA-256 `a740acb4727ca5141154617e47986de41a3c7cfbfdac2ec2c5885eace55552e7`, PR head `533bb00517ad0e9206ec34d2026a3977a2dc9a16`, fetched byte-exactly).

**Boundary contracts** (each located at its exact enforcing line): the [PR 386](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/386) sentence "COPY/ERASE windows remain sequential and immutable" (`research/split-centres-global/proofs/PR386-BIT-GEOMETRY.txt` line 54); wrapper counts bound to entering helpers (`code/assemble.py` line 102); wrapper factors charged per call (line 126); the selected deficit literal `owner deficit == 5120` (line 188); the supplier profile pins `expected.rank_mass` (line 67), `expected_profile` (line 85), `complete_contract` (line 92), `expected_local` (line 97), `expected.global_profile` (line 182). The provider local receipt has 13 fields; **none names a typed relabeling, a window width or a per-pair totals sink**.

**Dirty-column counts**: chain receipt 704 = 2x112 + 480 all-exact columns per call, 480 dirty helper columns, all restored true, 69,120 = 144 x 480 hosted roles; typed-window schedule at k=2 covers all 56 basis columns (every dirty state), with 0 dirty rows at block-2 entry for the legal per-call schedules (24 for the fused word, 16/24 for row-minimal deferral).

**Priced ledger** (width m = 73, live stock W = 14,336; exact moment acceptance is the chain's own `engines/moment.py` + `engines/base_two_moment.py` predicate, accept at the endpoint and reject at endpoint + 1e-24):

| ledger | D | endpoint (chain oracle) | cross-check |
|---|---:|---|---|
| chain receipt baseline | 5120 | 418747253984418082117/250000000000000000000000 | the chain's recorded `complex_lower`, accept/reject reproduced |
| published baseline | 5120 | 67018507072324140917/40000000000000000000000 | equals the published root 0.0016754626768081035 |
| chain shared (widened window, n_8 576) | 9728 | 796085643023976876837/250000000000000000000000 | above the certify ceiling (obstruction 1) |
| published shared (widened window) | 9728 | 1592621207654949794599/500000000000000000000000 | equals the PR 2595 enclosure [0.003185242415, 0.003185242416] |

The `a < D/E` screens remain screens: the chain engine's moment lower bound at the pinned `D_over_E_lo` already exceeds 1 (control `D_over_E_screen_not_acceptance`). Scalar side (PR 2595 machine receipt): k=2 pair 384 literal / 304 typed against 608 (224/304 primitives saved). One bounded pivot (k=5+5): phase-indexed readers 1,456 separate / 1,408 joint. The fixed-reader family is qualified by https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2626 (1,616 separate / 1,672 joint, 56 extra), so the widening decision should be priced on the phase-indexed family.

## Scoped obstructions (exact stage and error)

1. **Moment certification bracket.** The widened-window ledger's root (about 0.0031852) lies above the engine's hard-coded search ceiling `hi = Decimal('.003')` (`engines/moment.py` line 78); the final bracket assertion at line 86 fails (`AssertionError: assert lv[1]<1<hv[0]`). The engine's `moment()` acceptance oracle itself accepts the ledger at its own grid endpoint (found by bracket bisect on that oracle).
2. **Owner deficit literal.** With the widened ledger declared consistently (owner profile, rank mass, deficit 9728, per-call rank-8 children 8 to 4, adapter charges, pervertex and finite envelopes re-derived) and every SPEC pin relaxed, `code/assemble.py` still hard-codes `owner['deficit'] == 5120` (line 188, empty AssertionError).

Intermediary rejections, all recorded with their exact pins: the owner-ledger-only declaration dies at the per-call profile/idle consistency (line 130, rank-8 idle remainder 576 - 1152 negative: a per-pair sink has no per-call declaration); strict mode rejects both declarations at `SPEC MISMATCH expected.rank_mass: expected 1041408 got 1036800`; a scalar re-window is rejected at `SPEC MISMATCH providers.gauge44.complete_contract`.

## Named maintainer decisions

- **MD-1, widened-window / common-sink contract change** (the only decision that moves the moment ledger; consistent with https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2500 that the typed contract alone does not imply fewer recursive children). Admitting the shared ledger (n_8 1,152 to 576, D 5,120 to 9,728) needs: the [PR 386](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/386) sentence amended for one widened window with per-pair totals delivery; a per-pair sink declaration in the per-call receipt schema; the deficit literal replaced by the coverage identity; SPEC `expected.rank_mass` / `expected.global_profile` / `expected_profile` regeneration; and the moment engine's certify ceiling raised past about 0.0031852 or made adaptive. The chain's own moment oracle already accepts the shared endpoint.
- **MD-2, supplier admission fields for typed windows.** Declared fields for typed (frame-relabelled) window source rows, 8-row per-call windows and per-call totals delivery in the provider local receipt (today's 13 fields cannot express them), plus negative controls beside `false_dirty_restoration` in `code/assembly_controls.py`; a scalar re-window is rejected at the `complete_contract` / `expected_local` pins, so the admission route is a SPEC regeneration through the chain's discovery path with the new fields added.

## Admission disposition

| stage (pinned [PR 1087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087) chain) | run against the typed-window schedule | result |
|---|---|---|
| strict T16 replay (11 stages) | fresh run on the retained local word | passes on the frozen data (control) |
| admission-controls (69) | fresh run on the frozen receipts | passes; no control can bind a typed-window declaration (no field exists) |
| supplier-control (12) | fresh run on the frozen receipts | passes; bit supplier untouched (derived deficit 10272) |
| verify_t16-style binding checks | final binding assertions on the fresh outputs | pass (roles, calls, prefix, row coefficient, margins) |
| invoice/assembly boundary, frozen receipts | `assemble()` | passes, kappa reproduced |
| invoice/assembly boundary, widened-window ledger | `assemble()` probes | rejected at named pins and literals (above) |
| moment certification, both engines | both ledgers at their own endpoints | accept at endpoint, reject at +1e-24 (four ledgers) |
| scalar re-window declaration | `assemble()` probe | rejected at `complete_contract` |

## Scope and limits

Admission-stage evidence only. The typed echo is not placed on the selected 144-call schedule: `research/selected-centre-adjacent-pair-seed01fcb1` found no adjacent pair of that schedule sharing a physical owner among its eight centre source rows, so no placement exists without paid owner transport. The strict replay is the [PR 1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042) composition (kappa 0.001672188119205421), not the selected [PR 1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) record; the selected record is unchanged. The probes' re-derivation of the invoice envelope mirrors `code/assemble.py`'s formulas inside the probe harness only; the frozen files are untouched. Not checked: native emission, all-size/compiler, precision buckets, tape, analytic transfer, bit H1-H5. Not a multiplication theorem; admits no supplier.

**Baseline.** Canonical main moved during the session to `6bd33bc0b87a01e9c9d8b1c01576f3ddbcaee850` (priority revision 5 catalogue). The scientific baseline retained is the assignment-pinned `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, intentional: every pinned chain input (chain code, engines, contract text, frozen replay archive, selected record) is byte-identical on the new main; only `docs/research/agent-task-catalog.json` changed, and this package pins the base revision byte-exactly for reproducibility.

**Overlap** (entry survey and refined passes 16:41-17:50 UTC, complete pagination; no novelty is claimed). Predecessors: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2464, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2595. Adjacent concurrent work distinguished, not overlapped: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2626 (fixed-reader fusion tariff), https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2500 (typed contract vs recursive children), https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2491 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2543 (full dirty reader paired cycles), https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2502 (carry error envelopes), https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2158 (mutation coverage of the frozen invoice boundary: it mutates the frozen receipts to test guard coverage; this package declares the typed-window ledger against the same boundary and records where admission stops), Discussion 2576 (scoped full production replay of the unchanged chain).

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/z4-typed-window-admission-kb1c/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/z4-typed-window-admission-kb1c --check-only
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_Z4_TYPED_WINDOW_ADMISSION_KB1C controls=42 admission=69 supplier=12 kappa=0.001672188119205421 D=5120/9728 no_new_kappa
```

42 controls cover the k=2 invoices, savings, witness rows and basis coverage, the pivot prices and the [PR 2626](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2626) qualification, both coverage identities, the fresh replay verdict and its byte/semantic comparison against the pinned archive, all binding numbers, dirty-column counts, every boundary-contract location, the four moment accept/reject rows, the screen control, and all six assembly probes at their exact rejection points.
